title: The same nesting through script files with no inline code
threat_model: An attacker runs the same layers of interpreters, but from script files, so that no command line carries an inline-code option.
known_gap: interpreter_chain requires an inline-code option in some member of the chain. A chain of script files has none, so it is not seen however long it is.
notes: setup.sh writes bash, python3, sh and python3 script files with no -c or -e anywhere. The action's own bash -c carries a -c, which would make the chain alert if it were a member, so the action runs the first script through timeout, which forks its child and is not a watched program: the run of the chain ends at timeout and the wrapper is not part of it. The label stays expected because the attacker's goal is the same as in S08.
